Eating it will be a challenge because it's frozen solid, but if you persevere, it will temporarily increase your heat resistance.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Frozen Hearty Basses are a type of [[Frozen Food]], and they are made by chilling [[Hearty Bass]] in a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Eating one is difficult, but it will restore two [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]] and grant one minute of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Frozen Hearty Basses reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Hearty Bass]] to a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. Eating one is difficult, but it will restore two [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]] and grant one minute of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Bass * Frozen Food * Hearty Bass * Roasted Hearty Bass }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
